items.title: Tuesday's deep dive went overseas while a second report of the local strike story sat unused
items.detail: The Cariboo bar picked the Williams Lake Tribune's story on the Labour Relations Board ruling against Teck's replacement workers at Highland Valley Copper, then set it aside for want of a second report. The Tyee had one ("Teck Used Illegal Replacement Workers, Labour Board Finds", raw 72 on the day's charter), but it had no theme keyword, so it sat in the bonus stories the bar never sees, and it was cut from the roundup too. The deep dive aired four farm stories from Poland, Sweden and Australia instead. The review's "no Cariboo story or angle" item has now been seen 3 nights.
items.fix: Show the bar, as second reports only and never as a lead, the day's bonus stories whose headline shares a word with a local candidate (checked in Python, the same test the bar already uses: both headlines say "replacement workers"). Tuesday's deep dive would have been the strike ruling from two outlets. A few more stories in the one Haiku call, under $0.0001 a run. This changes what airs, so it needs your call.
items.source: Tonight's review (deep dive had no Cariboo story, 3 nights)
